pairs.name: callout card
pairs.why: Pins the phone path one pixel below the laptop flip. Only the callout card is paired: the composer and Next pairs of the 1280 case are phone-versus-laptop-design differences by construction, and the path identity here is asserted by the stage DOM hash (MAPPING 11g), which is byte-identical to a 390-wide phone.

pairs.name: chat invoice card
pairs.why: Size only: the export lays its canvas out at 44/248 inside the mock page, and the stage is 1380x860 against the design's 1440x900 canvas, so absolute x/y are offset on both axes. x is identical once the 44px page margin is removed (504) and y is identical measured from the stage's bottom edge (card bottom 100 above it in both).

pairs.name: card toggle
pairs.why: Same offset as the card; measured x 660 and h 28 match exactly.

pairs.name: line price
pairs.why: Height only: the pill is content-sized and the two players are sampled at different beats (the export has typed $400.00 = 88px by the time the app case finishes its 9s wait, whose scene 0 is still on the empty $Price = 76px). Both are 34 high, and with the same text both measure 88 (checked on the Clients tour's Save your jobs beat).

pairs.name: card footer
pairs.why: Same offset as the card; measured x 521 matches exactly.

pairs.name: spotlight target (composer)
pairs.why: Same offset as the card; the scrim cutout measured 0px from the composer's own rect.

pairs.name: next button (mid-tour)
pairs.why: Position inside the card is compared by inset instead (see MAPPING 11d): the pill is a child of the card, so page coordinates inherit the card's slot. Size: 91x36 at rest in both; the app's sampled box is up to 3px wider/taller when nextPulse's transform:scale is mid-loop (94-95 x 36-37), and 92 vs 91 at rest is our self-hosted Montserrat instance against the export's Google-font one.

pairs.name: next button (last scene)
pairs.why: The last scene's label shortens to "Got it" and the pill is content-sized: 79x36 in the export, 80x36 in the app (same Montserrat 1px, pulse-free layout size). This is what stops a gate on a fixed 91 width from passing while the label logic breaks.

pairs.name: save expense pill
pairs.why: Size only: the stage is 1380x860 against the design's 1440x900 canvas and its content area is 60 narrower, so x/y never compare absolute; the pill is 331x48 at the card's left gutter on both, 20 above the composer row's content edge.

pairs.name: ready chip
pairs.why: Size only (stage vs canvas offsets, as above); measured 147x30 in the design and 146x30 in the app, 21 from the card's left edge on both.

pairs.name: share buttons
pairs.why: Size only; 271 wide in the design's right column and 271 in the app's, 21 inside the card's right edge on both.

pairs.name: copy link
pairs.why: Size only; 132x46 in the design, 131x44 in the app (Tailwind preflight's border-box against the export's content-box).

pairs.name: revise tile
pairs.why: Size only; 271x92 on both, pinned to the bottom of the right column.

pairs.name: page header row
pairs.why: Size only: 720 wide on both, the design's 73 against the app's 72 is its 1px hairline counted outside the box (the app's is inside, border-box). y and x match absolutely once the export's 44px page margin is removed (-44,-248): 504,0 on both.

pairs.name: header icons
pairs.why: Size only; 84x40 on both, and x 1140 / y 16 (canvas-local) match exactly — the icon pair's right edge is the 720 column's right edge.

pairs.name: new chat icon
pairs.why: Size only; 40x40 on both at canvas-local 1140,16.

pairs.name: history icon
pairs.why: Size only; 40x40 on both at canvas-local 1184,16, i.e. the design's 4px gap.

pairs.name: camera tile
pairs.why: Size only, for the same canvas-inset reason as 11; 36x36 on both, and x is identical (1129) once the export's 44px page margin is removed, 5 inside the composer's right edge and 0 off its vertical centre.

pairs.name: card
pairs.why: size only: the design draws the card inside its 44px-margin mock browser frame, so absolute x/y do not transfer to a viewport-centred overlay

pairs.name: reason pill
pairs.why: height only: the pill is sized by its own copy (design 249px for "You have used your 3 free invoices"); the app keeps its own reason strings
